tests: DRV-01 child runner uses packaged Electron Node and explicit module/browser paths outside launch cwd
DRV-01 real child runtime resolves shipped Playwright without launch-directory modules
findings.change: process.execPath plus ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; explicit Playwright module root and bundled browser path; os.tmpdir execution directory. Main accepts isolated profile/hidden window for parent Electron E2E.

tests: EXE-01 graph treats production FAILURE/ERROR and legacy aliases truthfully and stops dependents
findings.change: Canonical SUCCESS/FAILURE/ERROR including legacy aliases; failure/error prevents stop-policy dependents. Unknown outcomes are ERROR.

tests: EXE-02 canonical security palette nodes and legacy underscore imports dispatch actual scan handlers
EXE-02 palette drop dispatches the same canonical types through the graph
findings.change: Canonical hyphen node types with intentional underscore import aliases; actual palette drop reaches scan handler.

tests: EXE-03 connected scans reach gates; missing/unavailable or unrelated evidence cannot pass
EXE-03 unavailable, incomplete, or unreadable scans stay ERROR instead of passing gates
findings.change: Scans publish artifacts.securityResults; connected ancestor scan evidence reaches gates, aggregated across branches. Missing, failed, malformed, unrelated or partial evidence cannot pass.

tests: EXE-04 actual website adapter status survives shared suite result normalization
findings.change: Shared core normalizes structured adapter status instead of checking only result.success. Website load event installed before src and timer cleared.

tests: EXE-05 saved input_files delivered to Python Java CSharp with legacy migration
findings.change: All Python/Java/CSharp adapters read persisted input_files; legacy inputFiles retained as fallback.

tests: EXE-06 stdout diagnostics never override authoritative success or failure
findings.change: Removed stdout keyword heuristics; runner status/exit result is authoritative.

tests: EXE-07 silent pipeline runs every configured row and passes graph inputs without UI
findings.change: Silent affects presentation, not dataset coverage. Every row runs with pipeline inputs, substituted expected output and saved file contents.

tests: EXE-08 data-driven completion updates one existing suite on repeated runs
findings.change: Data-driven completion updates existing suite metadata by id; no create call.

tests: EXE-09 concurrent creates updates deletes and view unassignment preserve every mutation
findings.change: Local read-modify-write commits synchronously before any await; concurrent mutations cannot use stale snapshots. View unassignment and tag batches await storage.

tests: EXE-10 Expected Output exact assertion applies to core and data-driven rows
findings.change: Shared core asserts exact Expected Output after CRLF normalization and removing one terminal newline, for ordinary and every data-driven row.

tests: EXE-11 individual unit Run uses graph injection/command adapter with upstream clone path
findings.change: Individual Unit Run and graph Unit Run share real test-file injection/command adapter, using upstream clone or configured CWD. Missing directory/API produces ERROR.

tests: EXE-12 editor working copy and returned graph never mutate saved nested data
findings.change: Deep clone into editor working state and deep clone on output. Unsaved nested edits cannot mutate saved pipeline.

tests: EXE-13 actual code scan receives checkbox categories; none selected is an error
findings.change: Stored checkbox booleans map to canonical scanTypes; editor stores array too. Zero selected categories is explicit ERROR.

tests: EXE-14 concurrent invocations have isolated files and clean up only their own directory
findings.change: Unique mkdtemp directory per invocation, own cleanup in finally, safe concurrent runs even identical timestamps.

tests: EXE-15 website edit method alias invokes existing toggle behavior
findings.change: Intentional toggleWebsiteMethod alias routes existing HTML/editor callers to implementation; full URL editor open regression.

tests: EXE-16 latest engine cycle errors persist ERROR and timestamp over old SUCCESS
findings.change: Engine exception updates lastRun/lastStatus ERROR and persists, replacing previously successful metadata.
